words.enDefinition: the ID card you use to borrow materials from campus libraries

examples.en: Your student ID doubles as your library card at the checkout desk.
examples.zh: 在借还服务台，你的学生证就是「借书卡」。

examples.en: Bring your library card when you pick up interlibrary loans at the front desk.
examples.zh: 去前台取馆际互借图书时要带上你的「借书卡」。

words.enDefinition: the number on your card used to log in to library services

examples.en: Type your library card number and PIN to renew books from home.
examples.zh: 在家续借图书时，输入你的「借书卡号」和密码。

examples.en: The barcode on the back is just your library card number in scannable form.
examples.zh: 背面的条形码其实就是可扫描版的「借书卡号」。

words.enDefinition: your online profile showing loans, holds, and fines

examples.en: Check your library account online to see which books you still have out.
examples.zh: 上网查看「图书馆账户」，看看还有哪些书没还。

examples.en: Unpaid fines appeared in my library account the morning after I missed a return.
examples.zh: 逾期还书的第二天早上，我的「图书馆账户」里就出现了未交罚款。

words.enDefinition: the rights that let you borrow items from the library

examples.en: Borrowing privileges are suspended until you settle the outstanding fine at the desk.
examples.zh: 在柜台结清未付罚款之前，你的「借阅权限」会被暂停。

examples.en: Grad students get extended borrowing privileges compared with undergraduates at most universities.
examples.zh: 在多数大学，研究生的「借阅权限」比本科生更长。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of items you can have out at once

examples.en: The borrowing limit for undergraduates is fifteen books and three media items.
examples.zh: 本科生的「借阅上限」是十五本书加三件音像资料。

examples.en: You hit the borrowing limit, so return something before checking out the next novel.
examples.zh: 你已达「借阅上限」，想再借小说得先还掉一本。

words.enDefinition: how long an item can stay checked out before returning

examples.en: The standard loan period is four weeks, and renewals add another four.
examples.zh: 标准「借阅期限」是四周，续借再加四周。

examples.en: Laptops have a shorter loan period than books, usually just four hours.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑的「借阅期限」比书短，通常只有四小时。

words.enDefinition: a registered person who uses library services and borrows items

examples.en: Library patrons can suggest titles the collection is missing through the website.
examples.zh: 「图书馆读者」可以通过网站推荐馆里缺的书目。

examples.en: The email went out to every library patron with items due that week.
examples.zh: 那封邮件发给了所有当周有书到期的「图书馆读者」。

words.enDefinition: the daily opening and closing times of the library

examples.en: Library hours shrink to eight until eight over winter break, so plan ahead.
examples.zh: 寒假期间「图书馆开放时间」缩短为早八点到晚八点，要提前规划。

examples.en: Check library hours before the holiday weekend because the branches close earlier.
examples.zh: 假日周末前查一下「图书馆开放时间」，各分馆会提早闭馆。

words.enDefinition: extra opening time added during busy study periods

examples.en: The library runs extended hours until 2 a.m. throughout finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周图书馆「延时开放」到凌晨两点。

examples.en: Extended hours start Monday, so the overnight study rooms will be busier.
examples.zh: 周一开始「延时开放」，通宵自习室会更抢手。

words.enDefinition: permission to enter the library when it is officially closed

examples.en: Grad students can apply for after-hours access with their supervisor's approval.
examples.zh: 研究生经导师同意后可以申请「闭馆后入馆权限」。

examples.en: After-hours access uses your ID badge on the side door card reader.
examples.zh: 「闭馆后入馆权限」需要在侧门读卡器上刷校园卡。

words.enDefinition: the largest central library on a university campus

examples.en: Meet me at the main library entrance before our two o'clock study session.
examples.zh: 两点自习前在「主馆」门口等我。

examples.en: The main library stays open all night, but the music branch closes early.
examples.zh: 「主馆」通宵开放，但音乐分馆很早就关门。

words.enDefinition: a smaller subject-specific library located away from the main one

examples.en: The science branch library keeps lab manuals the main building doesn't stock.
examples.zh: 理学「分馆」藏有主馆没有的实验手册。

examples.en: Architecture students do most of their borrowing at the art branch library.
examples.zh: 建筑系学生主要在艺术「分馆」借书。

words.enDefinition: a posted chart showing what is shelved on each floor

examples.en: Check the floor directory by the elevators to find the psychology section.
examples.zh: 在电梯旁的「楼层指引」上找到心理学藏区。

examples.en: The floor directory lists quiet zones, group pods, and every subject call range.
examples.zh: 「楼层指引」标出了静音区、研讨舱和各类目的索书号范围。

words.enDefinition: borrow a book by scanning it under your own account

examples.en: Use the self-service kiosk to check out a book without waiting in line.
examples.zh: 用自助借书机「借书」，不用排队。

examples.en: You can check out a book with your student ID at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 在借还服务台刷学生证就能「借书」。

collocations: check out a book at the kiosk
check out a book under my account
check out a book before the weekend

words.enDefinition: the deadline by which borrowed items must go back

examples.en: The receipt emails list the due date for loans so nothing slips your mind.
examples.zh: 借书回执邮件会写明「借书到期日」，免得你忘记。

examples.en: The due date for loans was pushed back a week because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 因为放假，这次的「借书到期日」往后推了一周。

collocations: check the due date for loans
extend the due date for loans
miss the due date for loans

words.enDefinition: extend the borrowing time for a book you keep

examples.en: You can renew a book twice unless another patron has placed a hold.
examples.zh: 只要没人预约，每本书你可以「续借」两次。

examples.en: Renew a book from the app instead of hauling everything back to campus.
examples.zh: 直接在App上「续借」，不用把书大老远搬回学校。

collocations: renew a book before the due date

words.enDefinition: extend loan periods through the library website or app

examples.en: Renew online the night before exams instead of carrying the books back.
examples.zh: 考试前一晚「在线续借」就行，不用把书背回去。

examples.en: I forgot to renew online, so the system emailed me an overdue warning.
examples.zh: 我忘了「在线续借」，系统就发来了逾期提醒。

words.enDefinition: a setting that extends loans automatically before they fall due

examples.en: The library's auto-renewal feature extended the loan before the book was due last Friday.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「自动续借」功能在上周五的到期日之前就给这本书续借了。

examples.en: I turned on auto-renewal so the library system could extend my eligible loans automatically.
examples.zh: 我开启了「自动续借」，这样图书馆系统就能为符合条件的借阅自动延长期限。

words.enDefinition: the slot where you drop books after the desk closes

examples.en: Feed the books into the book return chute by the entrance after closing.
examples.zh: 闭馆后把书从入口旁的「还书口」塞进去就行。

examples.en: The book return chute jams when everyone dumps hardcovers in during finals.
examples.zh: 期末大家都往「还书口」里塞精装书，很容易卡住。

collocations: book return chute by the entrance

words.enDefinition: an outdoor bin that accepts returns around the clock

examples.en: The drive-up book drop stays open even when the building is locked.
examples.zh: 即使馆内上锁，路边「还书箱」也全天可还书。

examples.en: Staff empty the book drop every morning before opening hours begin.
examples.zh: 馆员每天早上开馆前会清空「还书箱」。

words.enDefinition: reserve a borrowed-out item so it is saved for you
acceptedEnVariants: put a hold on a book

examples.en: Place a hold online and the library emails you when the copy lands.
examples.zh: 在网上「预约借书」，书一到馆图书馆就会给你发邮件。

examples.en: Someone beat me to the last copy, so I went online to place a hold.
examples.zh: 最后一本被人先借走了，我马上上网「预约借书」。

collocations: place a hold on a book
place a hold from the catalog

words.enDefinition: reserved for you and waiting at the pickup shelf

examples.en: Your request is on hold at the pickup shelf until Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 你预约的书在取书架上「留」到周五下午。

examples.en: Three people are ahead of me, so the novel is still on hold.
examples.zh: 排在我前面还有三个人，那本小说还在「预约等待」中。

collocations: on hold at the front desk

words.enDefinition: the waiting list of patrons ahead of you for an item

examples.en: I'm fourth in the holds queue for the statistics textbook everyone needs.
examples.zh: 那本人人都需要的统计学教材，我在「预约排队」中排第四。

examples.en: The holds queue moved faster than expected, and my notice arrived within days.
examples.zh: 「预约队列」走得比预想快，几天后取书通知就到了。

words.enDefinition: the days you have to collect an item before it is reshelved

examples.en: You get a five-day pickup window before reserved items go back on the shelf.
examples.zh: 预约的书有五天「取书时限」，过期就重新上架。

examples.en: Miss the pickup window and the book moves to the next person waiting.
examples.zh: 错过「取书时限」，书就会流转给下一位预约者。

words.enDefinition: an email telling you an item is ready to collect

examples.en: The pickup notice hit my inbox this morning about the interlibrary loan.
examples.zh: 今天早上邮箱收到了那本馆际互借书的「取书通知」。

examples.en: Check spam folders for pickup notices because the library server gets filtered sometimes.
examples.zh: 记得查查垃圾邮件，图书馆的「取书通知」有时会被过滤掉。

words.enDefinition: give up your place in line for a reserved item

examples.en: Cancel a hold if the edition the library bought doesn't match your syllabus.
examples.zh: 如果馆里买的版本和课程要求不符，就「取消预约」。

examples.en: It only takes a second to cancel a hold from your account page.
examples.zh: 在账户页面「取消预约」只需一秒钟。

collocations: cancel a hold from your account

words.enDefinition: a message demanding an early return because someone else needs it

examples.en: I got a recall notice because a professor put the book on course reserve.
examples.zh: 因为教授把这本书列为课程用书，我收到了「催还通知」。

examples.en: A recall notice shortens your loan, so return the item within ten days.
examples.zh: 收到「催还通知」后借期会缩短，要在十天内归还。

words.enDefinition: the shelving where held items wait under requesters' names

examples.en: Look for your last name on the reserve shelf behind the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 在借还台后面的「预约取书架」上找你的姓氏。

examples.en: Items on the reserve shelf are sorted alphabetically by the requester's surname.
examples.zh: 「预约取书架」上的书按预约人姓氏字母排序。

words.enDefinition: books a professor sets aside for a specific class

examples.en: Course reserves for econ 201 check out for just two hours at a time.
examples.zh: 经济学201的「课程预留图书」每次只能借两小时。

examples.en: Ask at the desk for course reserves because they never sit in the regular stacks.
examples.zh: 「课程预留图书」不放在普通书库里，请到柜台询问。

words.enDefinition: a reserve item that must return to the desk within two hours

examples.en: Most textbooks on course reserves are two-hour reserves that cannot leave the building.
examples.zh: 课程预留教材大多是「两小时短借」，不能带出馆。

examples.en: It's a two-hour reserve, so scan the chapters you need before returning it.
examples.zh: 这是「两小时短借」，还之前抓紧把需要的章节拍下来。

words.enDefinition: a long loan that lasts the entire term without renewals

examples.en: Grad students get semester loans on most books in their own subject area.
examples.zh: 研究生对本专业大部分图书享有「学期借阅」。

examples.en: The semester loan covers the whole spring term, including reading week and break.
examples.zh: 「学期借阅」覆盖整个春季学期，包括读书周和假期。

words.enDefinition: the desk or shelf where borrowed-from-other-library items are collected

examples.en: Interlibrary loan pickups wait at the same desk as regular holds.
examples.zh: 「馆际互借取书」和普通预约书在同一柜台领取。

examples.en: An email said my interlibrary loan pickup was ready at the east service desk.
examples.zh: 邮件通知我的「馆际互借取书」已在东侧服务台备好。

words.enDefinition: the money charged for each day a loan is late

examples.en: The overdue fine is twenty-five cents a day for regular circulating books.
examples.zh: 普通流通图书的「逾期罚款」是每天25美分。

examples.en: My overdue fine hit eight dollars before I noticed the due date passed.
examples.zh: 等我注意到到期日已过，「逾期罚款」已经攒到八美元。

words.enDefinition: an automated email warning that a loan is past due

examples.en: Overdue notices go to your campus email every three days after the due date.
examples.zh: 过了到期日后，每三天就会有一封「逾期通知」发到你的校园邮箱。

examples.en: I ignored two overdue notices before the fines finally got my attention.
examples.zh: 我无视了两封「逾期通知」，直到罚款多到引起重视。

words.enDefinition: far past the return deadline with fines piling up

examples.en: My statistics textbook is long overdue, so the fines doubled last week.
examples.zh: 那本统计学教材我已经「逾期很久」，罚款上周翻倍了。

examples.en: Books that stay long overdue eventually get billed as lost with a replacement fee.
examples.zh: 「逾期很久」的书最终会按丢失处理，要赔书款。

words.enDefinition: bringing an item back after its due date has passed

examples.en: A late return blocks new checkouts until you clear the fine at the desk.
examples.zh: 「逾期归还」后，结清罚款前不能再借新书。

examples.en: One late return during midterms cost me five dollars in fines.
examples.zh: 期中期间一次「逾期归还」让我花了五美元罚款。

words.enDefinition: give the library money owed for late or damaged items

examples.en: You can pay a fine at the circulation desk or online with a card.
examples.zh: 可以在借还台「交罚款」，也可以在网上刷卡支付。

examples.en: If the kiosk rejects your card, walk over and pay a fine in cash at the desk.
examples.zh: 如果自助机刷不了卡，就去柜台用现金「交罚款」。

collocations: pay a fine at the desk

words.enDefinition: formally challenge a charge you believe is wrong

examples.en: Dispute a fine within two weeks if the machine misread your return time.
examples.zh: 如果机器读错了你的归还时间，两周内可以「申诉罚款」。

examples.en: She went back to dispute a fine after proving the book drop stamped the correct day.
examples.zh: 她证实还书箱的盖章日期无误后，回去找馆员「申诉罚款」。

words.enDefinition: officially cancel a charge as a one-time courtesy

examples.en: The supervisor agreed to waive a fine because the catalog showed wrong closing hours.
examples.zh: 由于目录里显示的闭馆时间有误，主管同意「免除罚款」。

examples.en: Ask nicely and they may waive a fine once per academic year.
examples.zh: 好好说明情况，每年一次他们可能会给你「免除罚款」。

collocations: waive a fine for a first offense

words.enDefinition: a borrowed item you cannot find and must pay for

examples.en: Report a lost book right away so fines stop accruing on your account.
examples.zh: 一旦「遗失图书」要立刻报告，罚款才不会再累积。

examples.en: She declared the chemistry manual a lost book after searching her dorm twice.
examples.zh: 在宿舍翻了两遍之后，她把那本化学手册登记为「遗失图书」。

words.enDefinition: a book the catalog says is shelved but nobody can locate

examples.en: Staff run a search for missing books every Friday when the catalog says on shelf.
examples.zh: 每逢周五，馆员都会去寻找目录显示在架却找不到的「缺失图书」。

examples.en: Mark it as a missing book at the desk and they will email you if found.
examples.zh: 可以在柜台登记为「查架图书」，找到后他们会邮件通知你。

words.enDefinition: a returned item with stains, torn pages, or broken binding

examples.en: The clerk flagged a damaged book because water warped half the pages.
examples.zh: 图书管理员发现一本「污损图书」，一半书页都被水泡皱了。

examples.en: Return a damaged book immediately and explain what happened to avoid extra charges.
examples.zh: 「污损的书」要马上归还并说明情况，以免被加收费用。

words.enDefinition: the charge covering the cost of a lost or ruined item

examples.en: The replacement fee for a hardcover runs about forty dollars plus processing.
examples.zh: 精装书的「赔偿费」大约四十美元，另加手续费。

examples.en: Pay the replacement fee within a month and they refund it if the book turns up.
examples.zh: 一个月内交了「赔偿费」，之后若找到书还能退款。

words.enDefinition: the code on a book's spine showing its exact shelf position

examples.en: Write down the call number before you head into the stacks, or you'll wander.
examples.zh: 进书库前先抄下「索书号」，不然会瞎转半天。

examples.en: Books are arranged by call number, so read the labels from top to bottom.
examples.zh: 图书按「索书号」排列，看架标要从上往下读。

words.enDefinition: the shelved areas where most of the collection is stored

examples.en: The stacks on level four get warm and quiet by mid-afternoon.
examples.zh: 四楼「书库」到了下午会又暖和又安静。

examples.en: Wander the stacks near your subject and you'll always discover something useful.
examples.zh: 在本专业的「书库」里逛逛，总能发现有用的书。

words.enDefinition: walk the shelves looking for useful titles rather than searching

examples.en: Take an hour to browse the stacks near your call number for better sources.
examples.zh: 花一小时「浏览书库」里索书号附近的书架，找找更好的资料。

examples.en: Browse the stacks on level three when the search engine gives you nothing.
examples.zh: 检索系统没结果时，就去三楼「浏览书库」。

collocations: browse the stacks for an hour

words.enDefinition: the floor and section where a specific item is shelved

examples.en: The catalog lists the shelf location as Level 3, QA range, aisle twelve.
examples.zh: 目录显示这本书的「馆藏架位」在三楼QA区第12排。

examples.en: Copy the shelf location into your phone notes before climbing the stairs.
examples.zh: 爬楼梯前，先把「架位信息」记到手机备忘里。

words.enDefinition: physically shelved and available rather than borrowed or missing

examples.en: The app says it's on the shelf, but I couldn't find it anywhere in QA.
examples.zh: App 显示「在架可借」，但我在QA区怎么也找不到。

examples.en: If it shows on the shelf yet is missing, staff will search for you.
examples.zh: 如果显示「在架」却找不到，馆员会帮你查架。

words.enDefinition: currently borrowed by someone else and unavailable right now

examples.en: Every copy was checked out, so I placed a hold and waited two weeks.
examples.zh: 所有复本都「被借出」了，我只好预约等了两周。

examples.en: The catalog shows the DVD is checked out until next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 目录显示那张DVD「已借出」，下周二下午才会归还。

words.enDefinition: the catalog label showing whether an item is available or missing

examples.en: Check the item status before walking across campus for nothing.
examples.zh: 大老远跑一趟之前，先看看「馆藏状态」。

examples.en: The item status flipped from checked out to on hold for me overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，「馆藏状态」从已借出变成了为我预约待取。

words.enDefinition: the edge of a book that faces outward showing the label

examples.en: The call number is printed on the book spine, so tilt your head to read.
examples.zh: 「书脊」上印着索书号，得歪着头读。

examples.en: A cracked book spine usually means the volume was forced open too wide.
examples.zh: 「书脊」开裂通常说明这本书被人硬掰开过。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled cart holding books waiting to be reshelved

examples.en: Leave finished books on the book cart instead of reshelving them yourself.
examples.zh: 看完的书放到「书车」上，不用自己放回书架。

examples.en: The student worker wheeled a loaded book cart toward the history section.
examples.zh: 学生助理推着装满书的「书车」走向历史区。

words.enDefinition: a small stepladder kept in the aisles for reaching top shelves

examples.en: Grab the step stool to reach the oversized atlases on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 拿「取书梯凳」去够书架顶上的大开本地图册。

examples.en: Every aisle in the stacks has a step stool bolted near the end panel.
examples.zh: 书库每排书架末端都固定着一架「取书梯凳」。

words.enDefinition: a remote facility storing less-used items retrievable by request

examples.en: This journal sits in off-site storage, so delivery to the main library takes two days.
examples.zh: 这本期刊在「馆外书库」，调到主馆需要两天。

examples.en: Request items from off-site storage online and pick them up at the front desk.
examples.zh: 「馆外书库」的书可以在网上申请调阅，到前台取。

words.enDefinition: a suggestion asking the library to buy a specific title

examples.en: Submit a purchase request and the subject librarian replies within a week.
examples.zh: 提交一份「图书荐购」，学科馆员一周内会回复。

examples.en: The library bought my professor's monograph after three students filed purchase requests.
examples.zh: 三名学生都提交了「荐购」后，图书馆买下了教授的专著。

words.enDefinition: an encyclopedia or handbook kept in the library for use inside only

examples.en: Reference books like encyclopedias can't be checked out, so plan to photocopy pages.
examples.zh: 百科全书这类「工具书」不能外借，只能复印相关页。

examples.en: Ask the reference desk where the statistics handbooks and other reference books sit.
examples.zh: 到咨询台问一下统计手册等「工具书」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the non-circulating section of dictionaries, encyclopedias, and handbooks

examples.en: The reference collection stays beside the reference desk on the second floor.
examples.zh: 「工具书区」设在二楼咨询台旁。

examples.en: Items in the reference collection are stamped non-circulating on the spine.
examples.zh: 「工具书区」的书脊上都盖着不外借章。

words.enDefinition: the area where current magazines and journals are displayed

examples.en: The periodicals section keeps this month's magazines on racks near the windows.
examples.zh: 「期刊区」把当月杂志放在靠窗的架子上。

examples.en: Older journals move from the periodicals section into bound volumes on level four.
examples.zh: 过期期刊会从「期刊区」转到四楼的合订本区。

collocations: periodicals section on the ground floor

words.enDefinition: an older edition of a magazine kept after newer ones arrive

examples.en: Ask at the desk for back issues older than one year.
examples.zh: 一年以上的「过刊」需要向柜台索取。

examples.en: I photocopied an ad from a 1998 back issue for my media class.
examples.zh: 我从1998年的一期「过刊」上复印了一则广告，用于媒介课作业。

words.enDefinition: a protected area holding rare, old, or valuable materials

examples.en: Special collections on the basement level stores the university archives from 1892.
examples.zh: 地下层的「特藏部」保存着1892年起的校史档案。

examples.en: You need gloves and registration to handle manuscripts in special collections.
examples.zh: 在「特藏部」翻阅手稿需要登记并戴手套。

words.enDefinition: film strips storing old newspapers and documents for machine reading

examples.en: Nineteenth-century newspapers are on microfilm in the special collections reading room.
examples.zh: 十九世纪的报纸以「缩微胶片」形式保存在特藏阅览室。

examples.en: The microfilm reader prints fuzzy pages, so screenshot the viewer instead.
examples.zh: 「缩微胶片」阅读机打印的页面很模糊，不如直接截屏。

words.enDefinition: assigned articles and chapters for a class, often posted online

examples.en: Scan the QR code in the syllabus to find this week's course readings.
examples.zh: 扫大纲里的二维码，就能找到本周的「课程阅读材料」。

examples.en: Half of the course readings are scanned PDFs uploaded by the professor.
examples.zh: 一半的「课程阅读材料」是教授上传的扫描PDF。

words.enDefinition: a printed bundle of readings compiled for one specific class

examples.en: The course pack for marketing is cheaper to print at the library than to buy.
examples.zh: 市场学课的「课程讲义包」在图书馆自助打印比买便宜。

examples.en: Our professor put the whole course pack on file at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 教授把整份「课程讲义包」存在借还服务台。

collocations: course pack at the print desk

words.enDefinition: a display shelf showing books the library recently bought

examples.en: I skim the new arrivals shelf by the entrance before every study session.
examples.zh: 每次自习前我都会在入口旁的「新书架」上翻一翻。

examples.en: The new arrivals shelf rotates monthly with fresh fiction and popular science.
examples.zh: 「新书架」每月更新一轮新小说和科普书。

collocations: new arrivals shelf near the entrance
featured on the new arrivals shelf

words.enDefinition: a themed table of books arranged to catch browsers' attention

examples.en: The book display near the entrance features Asian American authors this month.
examples.zh: 本月入口处的「图书展台」主题是亚裔美国作家。

examples.en: Staff build a book display for every heritage month and exam season.
examples.zh: 每个文化月和期末季，馆员都会布置一个「图书展台」。

words.enDefinition: a relaxed collection of bestsellers and fiction for fun, not coursework

examples.en: The leisure reading corner stocks bestsellers and graphic novels upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼上的「休闲阅读区」摆着畅销书和漫画小说。

examples.en: Take a study break with something from leisure reading instead of doomscrolling.
examples.zh: 学习间隙去「休闲阅读区」挑本书，别一直刷手机。

words.enDefinition: a recorded reading of a book you stream or download

examples.en: The library app streams audiobooks free with your student login.
examples.zh: 用学生账号登录图书馆App就能免费听「有声书」。

examples.en: I finished the sociology reading as an audiobook on my commute.
examples.zh: 我通勤时用「有声书」听完了社会学阅读材料。

words.enDefinition: a digital version of a book readable on your devices

examples.en: If the print copy is checked out, the e-book is usually available instantly.
examples.zh: 如果纸质书被借走，「电子书」一般能马上看。

examples.en: Download the chapter as an e-book and annotate it on your tablet.
examples.zh: 把这一章下载成「电子书」，在平板上做批注。

words.enDefinition: the main circulating shelves, separate from reserves or reference

examples.en: Most novels sit in the general collection on floors three through five.
examples.zh: 大部分小说都在三到五楼的「普通书库」。

examples.en: Unlike course reserves, items in the general collection check out for weeks.
examples.zh: 与课程预留书不同，「普通书库」的书可以借好几周。

words.enDefinition: a year of magazine issues sewn into one hardbound volume

examples.en: Older issues are bound journals shelved by title on level four.
examples.zh: 过刊会做成「合订本期刊」，按刊名排在四楼。

examples.en: Pull the bound journal from the shelf and scan the article at the copier.
examples.zh: 从架上取下「合订本期刊」，在复印机旁扫描那篇文章。

words.enDefinition: the service point where librarians help you find sources

examples.en: The reference desk on level two helps you track down peer-reviewed sources.
examples.zh: 二楼的「参考咨询台」能帮你查找同行评审文献。

examples.en: Bring your assignment prompt to the reference desk and they'll suggest databases.
examples.zh: 带着作业要求去「参考咨询台」，馆员会推荐该用哪些数据库。

words.enDefinition: a librarian specializing in one department's research materials

examples.en: Email the subject librarian for chemistry if the databases overwhelm you.
examples.zh: 如果数据库用得晕头转向，就写信给化学「学科馆员」。

examples.en: Our subject librarian saved my thesis by digging up a 1970s survey report.
examples.zh: 「学科馆员」帮我挖出一份70年代的调查报告，救了我的论文。

words.enDefinition: a one-on-one appointment to plan a search strategy for a project

examples.en: Book a thirty-minute research consultation before you start the literature review.
examples.zh: 开始写文献综述前，先约一次30分钟的「研究咨询」。

examples.en: The research consultation showed me how to narrow my topic with Boolean operators.
examples.zh: 「研究咨询」教我用布尔运算符收窄选题。

words.enDefinition: a guided walk teaching new students the library's layout and services

examples.en: Take the library orientation tour during welcome week before the crowds arrive.
examples.zh: 开学周人还不多，先参加「图书馆导览」。

examples.en: The library orientation tour showed us the silent floors and the printing desk.
examples.zh: 「图书馆导览」带我们看了静音楼层和打印服务台。

collocations: sign up for the orientation tour

words.enDefinition: a free short class teaching one research or tool skill

examples.en: The library workshop on citation managers is free and runs every month.
examples.zh: 关于文献管理工具的「图书馆培训讲座」免费，每月举办一次。

examples.en: Sign up for the library workshop on systematic searching before your thesis proposal.
examples.zh: 开题前去参加图书馆的「系统检索培训讲座」。

words.enDefinition: an online page listing the best databases and sources for one subject

examples.en: The library's research guide for economics lists the key databases by topic.
examples.zh: 图书馆的经济学「研究指南」按主题列出了核心数据库。

examples.en: Start every assignment from the research guide instead of Googling blindly.
examples.zh: 写作业先从「研究指南」入手，别盲目谷歌。

words.enDefinition: a zone for solo work where talking is kept minimal

examples.en: The quiet study space on level two bans group work and phone calls.
examples.zh: 二楼的「安静自习区」禁止小组讨论和打电话。

examples.en: Find a quiet study space early, because they fill by ten during midterms.
examples.zh: 「安静自习区」要早点去占，期中期间十点前就满了。

words.enDefinition: a whole floor where no talking or calls are allowed at all

examples.en: Floor five is a silent floor, so take phone calls downstairs in the lobby.
examples.zh: 五楼是「静音楼层」，要打电话请下楼去大厅。

examples.en: I revise on the silent floor because even whispers get you stares there.
examples.zh: 我在「静音楼层」复习，那里连耳语都会招来白眼。

words.enDefinition: a casual space with couches where quiet talking and snacks are okay

examples.en: The fourth-floor study lounge lets you talk quietly and grab coffee.
examples.zh: 四楼「自习休息区」可以轻声聊天、喝咖啡。

examples.en: We held our group meeting in the study lounge instead of a booked room.
examples.zh: 我们小组会就放在「自习休息区」开，不用订研讨室。

words.enDefinition: your usual personal place to sit and work on campus

examples.en: The window seats on level six are my favorite study spot.
examples.zh: 六楼靠窗的位置是我最喜欢的「自习地点」。

examples.en: Everyone guards their study spot during finals, so arrive before the crowd.
examples.zh: 期末人人守着自己的「自习宝座」，你得赶在人流前到。

words.enDefinition: a large formal room with long tables for silent reading

examples.en: The historic reading room with green brass lamps stays open until midnight.
examples.zh: 那间装着绿色铜灯的老式「阅览室」开到午夜。

examples.en: Whispering is fine in the reading room, but calls must go outside.
examples.zh: 在「阅览室」里可以小声说话，打电话必须出去。

words.enDefinition: a modern open floor mixing study space, tech help, and tutoring

examples.en: The learning commons on floor two has couches, whiteboards, and a tech bar.
examples.zh: 二楼的「学习共享空间」有沙发、白板和技术服务台。

examples.en: Group projects run smoother in the learning commons than in the silent stacks.
examples.zh: 在「学习共享空间」做小组项目比在静音书库顺畅多了。

words.enDefinition: a small individual desk with walls for distraction-free solo study

examples.en: Grad students can request a locked study carrel for the whole semester.
examples.zh: 研究生可以申请一学期的带锁「自习隔位」。

examples.en: I plug in at a study carrel because the walls block every distraction.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在「自习隔位」学习，挡板能挡住一切干扰。

words.enDefinition: a desk beside a large window, prized for daylight and views

examples.en: I snagged a window seat overlooking the quad before eight this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上八点前我抢到了俯瞰草坪的「靠窗座位」。

examples.en: Window seats go first, so head straight upstairs when the doors open.
examples.zh: 「靠窗座位」最先被占，开门后要直接上楼。

words.enDefinition: a small private room one person books for focused work

examples.en: PhD students can book an individual study room for up to four hours.
examples.zh: 博士生可以预订「个人研究室」，一次最多四小时。

examples.en: The individual study room has a desk, a lamp, and soundproof walls.
examples.zh: 「个人研究室」配有书桌、台灯和隔音墙。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed booth for a team with a screen and a table

examples.en: Our group study pod has a big screen for sharing laptops during meetings.
examples.zh: 我们的「小组研讨舱」配有大屏幕，开会时可以共享电脑画面。

examples.en: Book a group study pod early because teams grab them right after dinner.
examples.zh: 「小组研讨舱」要早点订，晚饭后马上就被团队订光。

collocations: group study pod with a screen

words.enDefinition: sit at someone else's large table when free seats run out

examples.en: Mind if I share a table? Every single desk upstairs is full.
examples.zh: 我能「拼个桌」吗？楼上所有位子都满了。

examples.en: Strangers quietly share a table during finals without ever talking.
examples.zh: 期末时陌生人安静地「拼桌」，彼此一句话也不说。

words.enDefinition: how many free seats remain, often shown live in an app

examples.en: Check seat availability in the app before making the trip across campus.
examples.zh: 过来之前先在App上查一下「座位余量」。

examples.en: Seat availability dropped to five free desks by noon during reading week.
examples.zh: 读书周中午时，「座位余量」只剩下五个空位。

words.enDefinition: claiming seats with belongings while leaving them empty for hours

examples.en: Seat hogging with empty backpacks got called out in the library newsletter.
examples.zh: 用空书包「占座」的行为被图书馆通讯点名了。

examples.en: Staff now clear seat hogging after thirty minutes of unattended desks.
examples.zh: 现在「占座」超过三十分钟，馆员就会清桌。

words.enDefinition: the shortage of study seats when everyone revises at once

examples.en: The exam-season seating crunch means you need to arrive before nine sharp.
examples.zh: 「期末抢座难」，你得在九点整前到馆。

examples.en: During the exam-season seating crunch, students queue outside before the doors open.
examples.zh: 期末「抢座大战」时，学生们开馆前就在门口排队。

collocations: the worst seating crunch in December

words.enDefinition: bags and laptops left alone on seats, often removed by staff

examples.en: Unattended belongings get removed after thirty minutes when the floor is full.
examples.zh: 满座时，「无人看管的物品」三十分钟后就会被清走。

examples.en: A sign warns that unattended belongings may be moved to the front desk.
examples.zh: 标示上写着：「无人看管的物品」可能被移到前台保管。

words.enDefinition: stay settled in one library spot for many hours

examples.en: Engineering students camp out in the atrium the night before the mechanics final.
examples.zh: 力学期末考前夜，工科生们在中庭「安营扎寨」。

examples.en: I camped out at the same carrel for nine hours yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在同一隔位「安营扎寨」了九个小时。

words.enDefinition: a planned block of time spent studying, alone or with others

examples.en: We booked a pod for a three-hour study session tonight.
examples.zh: 我们今晚订了研讨舱，来一场三小时的「自习」。

examples.en: A quiet study session before eight is worth losing an hour of sleep.
examples.zh: 八点前安静地「自习」一场，少睡一小时也值。

words.enDefinition: reserving a group room through the library's online system

examples.en: Study room booking opens seven days in advance on the library website.
examples.zh: 「研讨室预订」在图书馆官网上提前七天开放。

examples.en: My study room booking vanished because I forgot to confirm within an hour.
examples.zh: 我一小时内没确认，那次「研讨室预订」就被系统取消了。

words.enDefinition: the maximum hours or rooms one group may reserve per day

examples.en: The booking limit is two hours per group per day in the science library.
examples.zh: 理学分馆的「预订上限」是每组每天两小时。

examples.en: We split the project across two pods to work around the booking limit.
examples.zh: 为了绕开「预订上限」，我们把项目拆到两个研讨舱进行。

words.enDefinition: a bookable room with a screen for rehearsing talks

examples.en: Reserve the presentation practice room to rehearse your slides with a timer.
examples.zh: 订一间「演练室」，对着计时器排练幻灯片。

examples.en: The presentation practice room records you, so you can watch your gestures after.
examples.zh: 「演练室」还能录像，练完可以回看自己的手势。

collocations: rehearse in the presentation practice room

words.enDefinition: the free page allowance each student receives for printing

examples.en: Your printing quota resets to fifty free pages at the start of every month.
examples.zh: 每月月初，「打印额度」会重置为五十页免费页数。

examples.en: I exceeded my printing quota, so the last ten pages charged my card.
examples.zh: 「打印额度」用超了，最后十页扣了我的卡。

words.enDefinition: a document sent to the shared printers, released at the station

examples.en: Send the PDF from your laptop, then release your print job at the station.
examples.zh: 先在笔记本上发送PDF，再到打印站「释放打印任务」。

examples.en: My print job sat in the queue for ten minutes because the toner ran out.
examples.zh: 因为没墨了，我的「打印任务」在队列里卡了十分钟。

words.enDefinition: the waiting line of documents ahead of yours at the printer

examples.en: The print queue backs up for twenty minutes around noon every day.
examples.zh: 每天中午前后，「打印队列」会积压二十分钟。

examples.en: Check the print queue before resending, or you'll print your essay twice.
examples.zh: 重发之前先看看「打印队列」，不然论文会打两份。

collocations: print queue at the front station

words.enDefinition: print on both sides of each sheet to save pages

examples.en: Print double-sided to stretch your semester quota across the whole term.
examples.zh: 「双面打印」能让一学期的打印额度撑得更久。

examples.en: Remember to print double-sided in the settings, or you'll waste fifty sheets.
examples.zh: 记得在设置里选「双面打印」，不然要浪费五十张纸。

words.enDefinition: printing in full color, which costs extra per page

examples.en: Color printing costs fifty cents a page, so save it for charts.
examples.zh: 「彩色打印」每页50美分，留给图表用就好。

examples.en: The color printer on level one handles color printing for posters too.
examples.zh: 一楼的彩色打印机也能做海报类的「彩色打印」。

collocations: send color printing to level one

words.enDefinition: sending documents to campus printers from a phone or laptop

examples.en: Mobile printing lets you send files from your phone before you even arrive.
examples.zh: 用「手机打印」，人还没到就能把文件发去打印站。

examples.en: Mobile printing failed twice, so I emailed the PDF to my roommate instead.
examples.zh: 「手机打印」失败两次，我干脆把PDF邮件发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: large-format printing for research posters and presentations

examples.en: Poster printing for the research symposium costs about ten dollars per sheet.
examples.zh: 学术海报展的「海报打印」每张大约十美元。

examples.en: Submit your poster file two days early, because poster printing takes time.
examples.zh: 「海报打印」耗时，海报文件要提前两天提交。

collocations: submit a file for poster printing

words.enDefinition: binding a report with a plastic coil so it lies flat

examples.en: Add spiral binding to your lab report for three dollars at the print desk.
examples.zh: 在打印台花三美元给实验报告加个「螺旋装订」。

examples.en: Spiral binding keeps the pages flat, which makes grading easier.
examples.zh: 「螺旋装订」能让书页摊平，老师批改更方便。

words.enDefinition: a copier feature that emails scanned pages as PDF attachments

examples.en: Use scan-to-email on the copier to save chapters without paying for prints.
examples.zh: 用复印机的「扫描到邮箱」功能，把章节存下来还不用花打印费。

examples.en: Scan-to-email failed until I typed my full campus address without typos.
examples.zh: 「扫描到邮箱」一直失败，最后发现是校园邮箱地址打错了。

words.enDefinition: a machine that makes paper copies for a small fee

examples.en: The photocopy machine on level one accepts coins and campus cards.
examples.zh: 一楼的「复印机」既收硬币也刷校园卡。

examples.en: There's always a queue at the photocopy machine the week before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前一周，「复印机」前总要排队。

collocations: photocopy machine by the reference desk

words.enDefinition: an overhead scanner that photographs pages without pressing the spine

examples.en: The overhead book scanner photographs pages without crushing the spine.
examples.zh: 这台顶置式「书籍扫描仪」拍照取页，不会压坏书脊。

examples.en: Scan your professor's old handbook with the book scanner instead of photocopying it.
examples.zh: 教授那本旧手册用「书籍扫描仪」扫，别拿去复印。

collocations: book scanner on the ground floor

words.enDefinition: borrowing a laptop for a few hours with your student ID

examples.en: Laptop loans run four hours and require your student ID at the desk.
examples.zh: 「笔记本电脑外借」时长四小时，需在柜台出示学生证。

examples.en: My laptop died mid-essay, so a laptop loan saved my deadline.
examples.zh: 写论文时电脑没电了，多亏「笔记本外借」救了截止日期。

words.enDefinition: borrowing cameras, recorders, or other gear through the library

examples.en: Equipment checkout covers cameras, tripods, and audio recorders for class projects.
examples.zh: 「设备借用」提供相机、三脚架和录音笔，供课程项目使用。

examples.en: Book equipment checkout online because camcorders vanish fast before presentation week.
examples.zh: 「设备借用」要在网上预约，展示周前摄像机很快被借光。

words.enDefinition: a locker bank that charges your phone while you study

examples.en: Locker-style charging stations by the entrance keep phones safe while you study.
examples.zh: 入口旁的储物柜式「充电站」能让你安心学习、安全充电。

examples.en: My phone hit five percent, so I parked it in a charging station.
examples.zh: 手机只剩百分之五的电，我把它放进「充电站」里充。

words.enDefinition: a workshop room with 3D printers and tools for student projects

examples.en: The basement makerspace has 3D printers, laser cutters, and sewing machines.
examples.zh: 地下室的「创客空间」配有3D打印机、激光切割机和缝纫机。

examples.en: Take the free training session before using anything in the makerspace.
examples.zh: 使用「创客空间」的设备前，先参加免费培训。

words.enDefinition: a soundproof room for recording presentations or language practice

examples.en: Book the recording booth to practice your Spanish oral exam quietly.
examples.zh: 订一间「录音间」，安静地练西班牙语口语考试。

examples.en: The recording booth comes with a microphone and headphones included.
examples.zh: 「录音间」自带麦克风和耳机。

words.enDefinition: a cable lock that secures your laptop to a desk

examples.en: Borrow a laptop lock at the desk if you step away from the carrel.
examples.zh: 如果要离开隔位，去柜台借一把「笔记本锁」。

examples.en: A laptop lock deters theft when you grab food between chapters.
examples.zh: 章节之间去吃饭时，「笔记本锁」能防贼。

collocations: secure your laptop with a lock

words.enDefinition: the cable that connects a laptop to the pod's screen

examples.en: Grab an HDMI cable from the pod's drawer to mirror your laptop.
examples.zh: 从研讨舱抽屉里拿一根「HDMI线」，把电脑画面投到屏上。

examples.en: The HDMI cable was missing, so we presented from the room's PC instead.
examples.zh: 「HDMI线」不见了，我们只好用室内的电脑来展示。

collocations: HDMI cable in the podium drawer

words.enDefinition: paying for a semester locker to store books inside the library

examples.en: Locker rental costs five dollars a semester at the circulation desk.
examples.zh: 「储物柜租用」每学期五美元，在借还台办理。

examples.en: With locker rental, I stop hauling heavy textbooks across campus daily.
examples.zh: 租了「储物柜」后，我不用每天把厚教材搬来搬去。

words.enDefinition: a public workstation with campus software any student can use

examples.en: Log into a library computer to run SPSS without buying a license.
examples.zh: 用「馆内电脑」跑SPSS，不用自己买授权。

examples.en: Save everything to cloud storage because library computers wipe at midnight.
examples.zh: 所有文件要存云端，「馆内电脑」午夜会清空数据。

collocations: save files from a library computer

words.enDefinition: the mobile app for renewals, holds, and room bookings

examples.en: Renew loans and check seat availability through the library app.
examples.zh: 通过「图书馆App」续借图书、查看座位余量。

examples.en: The library app scans the back cover barcode to check books out.
examples.zh: 「图书馆App」扫一下书底条形码就能自助借书。

words.enDefinition: the rules about snacks and beverages inside the library

examples.en: The food and drink policy allows covered drinks but no snacks near the computers.
examples.zh: 按「饮食规定」，可以带盖饮料，但电脑区不许吃零食。

examples.en: Read the food and drink policy before bringing noodles into the study lounge.
examples.zh: 想带泡面进自习休息区之前，先读一遍「饮食规定」。

collocations: follow the food and drink policy
food and drink policy on the website

words.enDefinition: a hold on your account that stops borrowing until resolved

examples.en: An unpaid fine put a library block on my account two days before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前两天，一笔未交罚款给我的账户上了「借阅冻结」。

examples.en: The library block lifted the morning after I paid the replacement fee.
examples.zh: 交完赔偿费的第二天早上，「借阅冻结」就解除了。

collocations: a library block on your account

words.enDefinition: an alert set before a loan is due back

examples.en: Set a due-date reminder two days before the return deadline.
examples.zh: 在归还截止前两天设一个「到期提醒」。

examples.en: My due-date reminder pinged while I was still fifty pages from finishing.
examples.zh: 「到期提醒」响的时候，我还差五十页没读完。

words.enDefinition: collecting reserved items outside without entering the building

examples.en: I used curbside pickup when the lobby was closed for renovations.
examples.zh: 大堂翻修闭门期间，我用了「馆外取书」服务。

examples.en: Call the number on the sign and staff bring curbside pickup orders out within minutes.
examples.zh: 拨打标牌上的电话，馆员几分钟内就会把「馆外取书」的订单送出来。

collocations: curbside pickup at the east entrance

words.enDefinition: the prepaid money your account spends when printing beyond quota

examples.en: Add print credit online before the weekend rush at the print stations.
examples.zh: 周末打印站高峰前，先在线给「打印余额」充值。

examples.en: My print credit ran out mid-essay, and the machine refused the last page.
examples.zh: 论文打到一半「打印余额」用完了，最后一页机器直接拒打。

words.enDefinition: fold a page corner down to mark your place

examples.en: Don't dog-ear library pages; grab a free bookmark at the desk instead.
examples.zh: 别把图书馆的书页「折角」，柜台有免费书签。

examples.en: The previous borrower dog-eared half the novel, and I still had to return it.
examples.zh: 前一位借书人把半本小说都「折了角」，可我还是得原样归还。

words.enDefinition: a spilled-drink mark that counts as damage on library books

examples.en: A coffee stain on page 120 turned into a twenty-dollar damage charge.
examples.zh: 第120页上的一块「咖啡渍」让我赔了二十美元。

examples.en: Keep lids on drinks, because one coffee stain ruins the whole loan.
examples.zh: 饮料要带盖，一滴「咖啡渍」就能毁了整本书。

collocations: a coffee stain on page ten

words.enDefinition: quiet someone with a sharp sh sound, as librarians famously do

examples.en: We got shushed within a minute of laughing on the silent floor.
examples.zh: 在静音楼层刚笑出声，一分钟内就被人「嘘」了。

examples.en: The librarian shushed two freshmen for calling across the reading room.
examples.zh: 图书馆员对在阅览室里喊话的两个新生发出了「嘘」声。
